name: android-reverse-engineering
description: Decompile Android APK/JAR/AAR with jadx, trace call flows, and document extracted APIs. Unity IL2CPP: headless Ghidra (pyghidra) + Il2CppDumper pipeline recovers method bodies; UnityPy + AssetStudioMod extract scene hierarchy, serialized component values, textures, meshes, animations, audio.
